mutants.description: Formats the last-updated time with the shell's delivered formatTimestamp (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS America/Chicago) and re-adds an importer of status-region.tsx: the review v2 IR-001 defect (ui-components design 2.5 'every CAP-003 surface uses formatInstant'; UX design 0.7; DAC-E3-15)

Renders the last-updated time as formatClock's HH:MM:SS zone, without the date, on a line that carries no date (UX design 0.7 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM zone, or HH:MM zone where the date is already on the line'; ui-components design 2.5 formatClock only for 'checked {time}')
Adds seconds to the last-updated time (UX design 0.7 form YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM zone; ui-components design 2.5 keeps seconds for the unreachable state's Last answered only)

Shows the time of rendering instead of the time the list was read (fetchedAt), so a redraw moves the time without a re-read (UX design 1.6 States last-updated time; review v1 IR-001 remediation 'from fetchedAt')

mutants.old: Last updated {formatInstant(new Date(populated.fetchedAt))}
mutants.description: Removes the populated table's last-updated line: the Stale row of the state table (UX design 1.6 States 'last-updated time'; capability AC-24; review v1 IR-001)
Renders the raw ISO-8601 UTC string instead of UX design 0.7's America/Chicago form with the zone shown (AC-24; review v2 IR-001)
Drops the time of day from the last-updated time, leaving only the date (UX design 0.7 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM zone)
Drops the zone from the last-updated time (UX design 0.7 'timestamps are America/Chicago with the zone shown, CDT or CST'; STD-UI-5)
Renders only HH:MM zone, the short form UX design 0.7 allows only where the date is already on the line, which it is not here
Labels every instant CST, also in daylight time (UX design 0.7 'CDT or CST as the instant falls'; ui-components design 2.5)
Labels every instant CDT, also in standard time (UX design 0.7 'CDT or CST as the instant falls'; ui-components design 2.5)
Writes the zone as the IANA name America/Chicago rather than its abbreviation (UX design 0.7 'CDT or CST'; review v2 IR-001)
Renders the UTC wall-clock time under a Chicago zone label instead of converting to America/Chicago (UX design 0.7; STD-UI-5)
Renders the last-updated time in the viewer's locale and machine zone (UX design 0.7 'never a locale format'; STD-UI-5; ui-components design 2.5)
Changes the line's words away from 'Last updated' (UX design 1.6 States last-updated time; review v1 IR-001 'Last updated {time}')
Drops the time from the last-updated line, leaving only its label (UX design 1.6 States last-updated time; capability AC-24)
